release: Ships the render/interaction/stability accuracy work (committed in 855b10a, authored in another session) plus two test-integrity fixes. IMPACT MEASURED BEFORE SHIPPING, not asserted: same site, same options, engine 6.1.4 vs this build, 2 pages at 390px. RESP-004 element-wider-than-viewport went 12 findings to 0 - every one was an element inside an ancestor with overflow-x hidden/auto/scroll, i.e. contained and unable to widen the page. Width alone was never the defect; width that ESCAPES is. Responsive suite 81 to 91. A11Y-002 contrast went 15 findings to 20 - it now flattens translucent layers and gradient stops instead of failing to read the ground, so it SEES MORE than before. This is the correction to a claim made when the work was committed: it is not a blanket findings-reduction, it is an accuracy change, and in one direction it finds more. Overall quality 75 to 76 on this sample; failures 3 to 2. Also in scope: WCAG 2.5.8's in-a-block-of-text exemption for inline tap targets, iOS zoom scoped to controls that accept typed text, FORM-002 no longer telling hidden/radio/checkbox fields to become text inputs, and script/style/comment bodies stripped before the interaction scan so a button written inside a JS string stops opening a phantom element that nests every real control after it. TEST INTEGRITY: seo-split.test.js chose its server port as 7800 + (pid % 90). Seven leaked node servers squatting 7879-7886 made it 1/21 inside run-all while it passed 58/58 standalone - a suite whose colour depends on the PID trains everyone to re-run until green, which is how a real failure gets waved through. It now asks the OS for a free port. And PASS_LABEL gained the seven checks that ran clean and emitted no row at all (6.1.4), so the Content and SEO card stops printing NOT RUN for checks the coverage ledger recorded as verified.
